subject: DS474
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos, 5 for each language, covering all specified topics. For English, choices were driven by a combination of high relevance and massive view counts from reputable channels. For Arabic, the selection pool was smaller, but strong candidates were found for each topic, with some topics having fewer eligible videos due to view count or duration constraints. All selected videos are directly relevant and provide a solid educational foundation for university students.

coverage.note: Most candidates failed on view count or duration gates.
Several candidates were about Google's Gemini Spark, not Apache Spark, or failed language/view count gates.
One strong candidate failed the duration gate.

videos.title: Explaining Big Data
videos.filter_reason: A high-quality, very popular video that explicitly covers the characteristics (V's) of Big Data in its description and tags.

videos.title: What is MapReduce♻️in Hadoop🐘| Apache Hadoop🐘
videos.filter_reason: This is a perfectly titled, highly relevant, and very popular video from a trusted educational channel that clearly explains MapReduce within the Hadoop context.

videos.title: Learn Apache Spark in 10 Minutes | Step by Step Guide
videos.filter_reason: An extremely popular and well-regarded introduction to Apache Spark that clearly explains the architecture and core concepts in a concise 10-minute format.

videos.title: Cloud Computing Services Models - IaaS PaaS SaaS Explained
videos.filter_reason: This video has massive reach, indicating strong peer validation, and provides a very clear and direct explanation of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.

videos.title: What Is GIS? A Guide to Geographic Information Systems
videos.filter_reason: A very popular and well-produced introduction to GIS, which is the foundational technology for geospatial analytics, covering its core concepts and applications.

videos.filter_reason: This was the best eligible candidate, providing a clear, structured explanation of Big Data characteristics with timestamps for easy navigation.

videos.title: 2. MapReduce | خطط واختصر
videos.filter_reason: An excellent, in-depth explanation of MapReduce from a highly respected Arabic Big Data channel, based on the authoritative 'Hadoop: The Definitive Guide' book.

videos.title: 01- Introduction to Spark [ سبارك بالعربى ] Spark in ARABIC
